name: Shield & Speed
direction: A shield and a lightning trail become bold comic caption surfaces.
detail: A wide energetic comic cover: classic adult Captain America on the left in his fully covered blue suit, gloves, boots and winged blue mask, holding his round red-white-blue shield. Adult The Flash on the right in his fully covered red suit, cowl and yellow boots, running alongside him rather than fighting. The setting is a sunlit graphic city avenue with broad cream sky and cobalt architecture. Oversized comic speed lines sweep across the ground. Two enormous cream COMIC SOUND-EFFECT PLAQUES lie within the action, one overlapping the shield's lower silhouette reading CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT, the other carried by a yellow lightning-shaped ribbon reading CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. Dynamic readable poses, bright optimistic palette, hefty vintage comic lettering. This is an illustrated scene with numbers woven into it, not a dashboard.

name: Sky & Sea
direction: Clouds and waves divide a mythic elemental print.
detail: An elegant elemental comic-art diptych. Adult Storm on the left, dark skin and flowing white hair, wearing a fully covered high-neck white and gold superhero jumpsuit and cape; adult Aquaman on the right wearing complete orange scale armour and green gloves. Both shown from the waist up in calm heroic poses. A great curling cobalt ocean wave mirrors Storm's white cloud and cape. Broad cream sky, golden sun, economical green accents. Two LARGE LIGHT CAMEOS naturally formed by cloud and sea-foam carry the lettering in dark black ink: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT on the cloud left; CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT on the wave right. Organic curves, bold woodcut-like comic contours and clean spacious numeric interiors. No skin exposure below either collar, no battle or threats.

name: Strength & Steel
direction: A comic portrait contrast between green power and silver machinery.
detail: A bold humorous waist-up comic portrait pairing. Hulk on the left has his recognizable green face and enormous green gloved hands, wearing a complete purple high-neck heavy jacket covering his torso and arms. Cyborg on the right wears complete white-silver and cobalt technological armour, his adult face partly framed by machinery. Both are peacefully checking their reserves, with expressive surprised versus confident faces. Behind them: simple green and cobalt blocks and cream paper. Huge rounded rectangular CREAM EQUIPMENT TAGS hang prominently in front of their jackets/armour as part of the drawing: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT left; CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT right. Tags occupy lower third, portraits upper two thirds. Broad shoulders, restrained technical detail, chunky black ink and clean flat colour. Friendly comic humour, no violence or nudity.

name: Wild Cards
direction: Two oversized illustrated playing cards with comic portraits.
detail: A sophisticated graphic comic poster built from TWO OVERSIZED PLAYING CARDS, tilted slightly towards each other but with easily readable lettering. On the left card, adult Wolverine wears his fully covered classic yellow-and-blue suit and iconic yellow-and-black mask; show his head and shoulders and no claws. On the right card adult Green Arrow wears his fully covered green hooded costume, mask and gloves; no bow or arrows aimed at anyone. Expressive ink portraits fill the upper half of each card, and LARGE CLEAR LOWER CARD FIELDS display CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT left, CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT right. No card-rank numbers or extra numerical markings. A simple yellow burst, green leaves and cobalt paper shadows behind the cards give depth. Collectible vintage trading-card illustration, cream paper, thick linework, beautiful generous margins, minimalist background.
